claims.statement: Silverquill is Strixhaven's white-black College of Eloquence.
The 2021 guide describes Silverquill mages as masters of word magic through spoken-word battle poetry and magical written manifestations.
The 2021 guide describes Silverquill mages as stylish, intimidating, driven, competitive, and natural leaders.
The 2026 guide emphasizes Silverquill magic through spoken, written, and signed word, manifesting as calligraphic strokes of ink and light.
The 2026 guide lists Silverquill study areas including linguistics, political science, sociology, education, law, espionage, and journalism.
Silverquill placement signals should weight rhetorical precision, leadership presence, reputation, influence, and awareness that words change power relationships.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
